Interface AopInfrastructureBean

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractAdvisingBeanPostProcessor, AbstractAdvisorAutoProxyCreator, AbstractAutoProxyCreator, AbstractBeanFactoryAwareAdvisingPostProcessor, AnnotationAwareAspectJAutoProxyCreator, AspectJAwareAdvisorAutoProxyCreator, AsyncAnnotationBeanPostProcessor, BeanNameAutoProxyCreator, ConcurrencyLimitBeanPostProcessor, DefaultAdvisorAutoProxyCreator, InfrastructureAdvisorAutoProxyCreator, MethodValidationPostProcessor, PersistenceExceptionTranslationPostProcessor, ProxyProcessorSupport, RetryAnnotationBeanPostProcessor, ScopedProxyFactoryBean
public interface AopInfrastructureBean
指示属于 Spring AOP 基础设施的 Bean 的标记接口。特别是，这意味着任何此类 Bean 都不受自动代理的影响，即使切面匹配也是如此。
